claims.statement: The implemented scalar, O(2) matter and (diagonal) metric field equations of the UET parent code follow from the Theory Card action UET-PARENT-ACTION-001.
claims.note: Mathematical consistency only; says nothing about whether nature follows this action.

claims.statement: epsilon is not an independent coupling of the parent action: in canonical variables xi_c and m_psi are epsilon-independent, lambda_psi ~ 1/epsilon and g_c ~ sqrt(epsilon), so epsilon = 0 is a degenerate point rather than a continuous GR limit.
